headline: Ashland hand Cedarville their first defeat by a conference rival
dek: Eleven days after losing on the same ground, Ashland went back to Cedarville and won, with the only goal they have scored against them in three meetings this season. It was one of four goals Cedarville have conceded in twenty matches.
